hotels.description: Escape to a private island sanctuary where luxury meets nature in perfect harmony. Nestled in the remote Raa Atoll, just a breathtaking 45-minute seaplane ride from Malé, this pool villa paradise is your gateway to serenity. Surrounded by lush greenery, crystal-clear waters, and vibrant marine life, the resort’s 81 villas-each with a private pool-blend minimalist elegance with total seclusion. Whether perched above the water or tucked along the beach, every villa is a haven of space, style, and tranquillity. Dine your way around the globe with six unique venues serving bold flavours, from Mediterranean and Arabic to Japanese and Portuguese. For those seeking tranquillity, the resort's spa offers a range of rejuvenating treatments, inspired by ancient Asian healing techniques.
